answer: An oasis cooperative buys warnings of ember drift toward its yarrow fields. Each seller answers a random, short-lived challenge with a live reading from a registered station; its secure counter signs for only one account per interval. Rewards are per verified station-hour, so fifty aliases relaying one feed share one payment. To collect fifty fees, an attacker must run fifty stations and pay for power, maintenance and slashable deposits. A compromised counter or colluding auditors could fake coverage, so compare surprise satellite and neighboring-station readings.
